title: AI in the Workplace
abstract: What is AI? And how does AI affect the work the Chemical Engineers do? As AI is becoming a highly utilized or even an essential technology in recent years, companies are looking for ways to leverage the AI technology in their day-to-day operations to increase efficiency of currently used methods. For example, by utilizing AI, companies can now expand their knowledge base resulting in more refined method development and product testing. Generative AI, such as large language models (LLM), further opens the opportunities to create new text and image contents. Join the Early Career Community (ECC) as we discuss how AI is currently emerging in the Chemical Engineering space. The potential challenges posed by AI will also be explored, such as data bias, job displacement, and overreliance on automated systems.
